root_cause: inventory-service fails internally on a corrupted stock ledger: the checksum mismatch makes it return 500s, and checkout-service surfaces them as dependency failures

evidence.observation: 334 events, all error_type=StockLedgerCorruption with a checksum mismatch on the stock ledger
evidence.supports: the fault is internal to inventory-service and names itself
checkout-service sees the failure, it does not cause it - the counts match one for one
the failure is confined to one dependency

evidence.observation: stayed at 0.0 for the whole window
evidence.supports: checkout-service itself is healthy - nothing queues on its database pool

ruled_out: connection pool exhaustion in checkout-service - db_pool_usage stayed at 0.0 throughout, where an exhausted pool climbs toward 1
a merely slow inventory-service - p95_by_dependency[inventory-service] rose only x2.25 while 334 inventory_internal_error events were emitted; latency alone produces no such event
memory leak - memory_mb went 89.3 to 93.3 and cache_entries stayed at 0, both among the metrics that stayed normal
